entries.english:
Co-guardianship of Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg over the sons Ludwig, Philipp, and Albert of the late Albrecht von Liebenstein.

Date range: 1600–1630

Contains: 1. Folios 1–261, general guardianship matters, including the sons’ education and travels, administration of the Liebenstein estates, and correspondence between the guardians, 1607–1625; 2. Folios 262–366, marriage of Ludwig von Liebenstein to Maria Brigitta von Aschhausen, 1612–1613; 3. Folios 368–406, disputes between Pleikart von Helmstadt on one side and Ludwig, Philipp, and Albrecht von Liebenstein on the other concerning the estate of Margaretha von Liebenstein née von Hutten, 1611; 4. Folios 407–423, Anna Margaretha von Liebenstein, wife of Pleikart von Helmstadt, renounces claims to the inheritance of her father, mother, and brothers, reserving her claims to the estates of her uncles Georg Sigmund and Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg, 1611–1612; 5. Folios 424–440, dispute between Konrad von Liebenstein and Pastor Daniel Xylander at Ottmarsheim over the small tithe, 1610; 6. Folios 441–448, appointment of M. Christian Oswald as deacon at Bönnigheim, 1616; 7. Folios 450–453, intercession by the Count of Löwenstein for Melchior Haug of Löwenstein concerning release from Liebenstein serfdom, 1610; 8. Folios 454–463, enfeoffment of Albrecht von Liebenstein with Würzburg fiefs, 1624; 9. Folios 464–468, confiscation of the Liebenstein brothers’ possessions by imperial commissioners because of their military service under Count von Mansfeld, 1630; 10. Folios 469–474, complaint by Hans Baumann of Bönnigheim against his punishment by the co-heirs, 1613; 11. Folios 475–485, miscellaneous correspondence, mainly concerning the dispute between Rosenberg and Haugwitz, 1600–1614.

Extent: 1 volume, folios 1–485
